sections.title: budget-review
sections.sql: SELECT code,currency,approved_cents,allocated_cents,actual_cents,projected_cents,headroom_cents,unallocated_cents FROM budget_spend ORDER BY code

sections.title: reforecast-due
sections.sql: SELECT campaign,reference,owner,currency,projected_cents,forecast_on,forecast_age_days FROM line_spend WHERE forecast_age_days>14 ORDER BY forecast_on,campaign,reference

sections.title: actions-due
sections.sql: SELECT c.code campaign,a.id,a.note,a.owner,a.due_on FROM actions a JOIN campaigns c ON c.id=a.campaign_id WHERE a.closed_at IS NULL AND a.due_on<=current_date+7 ORDER BY a.due_on,c.code

sections.title: campaign-review
sections.sql: SELECT code,owner,currency,allocation_cents,actual_cents,outstanding_cents,projected_cents,headroom_cents,stale_forecasts FROM campaign_spend ORDER BY code

sections.title: commitments-due
sections.sql: SELECT campaign,reference,supplier,owner,currency,outstanding_cents,due_on FROM line_spend WHERE outstanding_cents>0 AND due_on<=current_date+14 ORDER BY due_on,campaign,reference

sections.title: Records needing review
sections.sql: SELECT * FROM compliance_issues ORDER BY rule,record
